post.summary: Creates a Playbook in the specified workspace.

> [!NOTE]
> Playbook item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

Creates an empty Playbook when no definition is supplied. When a definition is supplied, the complete desired section hierarchy is created.

- The workspace must be on a supported Fabric capacity.

The caller must have an effective *Curator* role on the section or an ancestor.
